message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “flexible” card: it can be worth **either 1 or 11 points**—whichever gives your hand the best possible total without going over 21.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your hand ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would bust you, you treat the Ace as 1 instead.  

This flexibility also applies when you have multiple Aces: one Ace will normally count as 11 and any additional Aces as 1 (so two Aces together are worth 12, three Aces are worth 13, etc.).  

A natural Blackjack (an Ace plus a 10‑value card) always counts as 21 and pays out at 3:2.
